summary: UA's renowned sports festival pits Izuku Midoriya against talented classmates like fire and ice wielder Shouto Todoroki, forcing him to win with his wits and a powerful but inefficient quirk.

title: Vinland Saga

title: Violet Evergarden

title: Horimiya

title: Akame ga Kill!
summary: Naive village boy Tatsumi joins Night Raid, the Revolutionary Army's assassins, to fight the corrupt Empire of Prime Minister Honest, facing powerful weapons, enemy assassins and his own morals.

title: Noragami

summary: Interning under Sir Nighteye, Izuku Midoriya uncovers the crime syndicate of the villain Overhaul, Kai Chisaki, and teams up with Mirio Toogata to save a mysterious young girl named Eri.

summary: Ten years after the Holy Knights seize the Kingdom of Liones, its third princess, Elizabeth, searches for the legendary Seven Deadly Sins, hoping their help can take her kingdom back.

title: Bleach
summary: After his family is attacked by a Hollow, Ichigo Kurosaki takes the powers of injured Soul Reaper Rukia Kuchiki and must hunt the Hollows plaguing his town alongside his gifted classmates.

summary: As the second term begins, Kaguya Shinomiya agonizes over how to celebrate Miyuki Shirogane's birthday, while the 67th student council's term ends and a tough presidential election looms.

summary: Searching for her father's killer, Ryuuko Matoi arrives at Honnouji Academy, ruled by Satsuki Kiryuuin. Armed with the Scissor Blade and the sentient uniform Senketsu, she takes on the Elite Four.

summary: When the game Yggdrasil shuts down, the wizard Momonga stays logged in and finds himself trapped as his character, with NPCs who now have minds of their own. He sends his servants to explore this new world.

summary: Novice Diver Riko, daughter of the missing White Whistle Lyza, finds a robot boy with no memories and names him Reg. Together they descend into the Abyss to find his past and see its bottom.

summary: A street kid in a future city obsessed with technology and body modification fights to survive by becoming an edgerunner, a mercenary outlaw also known as a cyberpunk.

summary: Driven from Ente Isla by the hero Emilia, Demon Lord Satan lands powerless in modern Tokyo, takes the name Sadao Maou, and works at MgRonald's while plotting to rule Earth one customer at a time.

summary: At Death City's Death Weapon Meister Academy, meister Maka Albarn and her scythe partner Soul Eater Evans collect the souls of 99 evil beings and one witch to turn Soul into a Death Scythe.

summary: Reclusive Jinta Yadomi begins seeing the ghost of his childhood friend Menma, who died years ago and wants a forgotten wish granted. His drifted-apart friends reunite to help her spirit move on.

summary: Momo, from a family of spirit mediums, and occult fan Okarun argue over ghosts and aliens. Testing each other at a UFO site and a haunted tunnel, she awakens hidden powers and he gains a curse's power.

summary: Transfer student Kouichi Sakakibara joins Yomiyama North's class 3-3, where everyone treats the eyepatch-wearing Mei Misaki as if she does not exist, and he begins to uncover a deadly phenomenon.

summary: Back at Irlam village, Subaru Natsuki finds the ruin left by the Sin Archbishops. Seeking answers at the Sanctuary, he meets Echidna, the Witch of Greed, as threats close in on the people trapped there.

summary: Cynical Hachiman Hikigaya is forced into the Volunteer Service Club as punishment for a mocking essay, where he and icy Yukino Yukinoshita take on other students' problems.

summary: Underground villagers Simon and Kamina find the ancient war machine Lagann, fend off a surface attack with gunslinger Yoko Littner, and head into the wasteland to fight the Beastmen and their Gunmen.

summary: Aspiring mage Lucy Heartfilia is saved from kidnappers by Natsu Dragneel, who is searching for the dragon Igneel, and joins his famous guild Fairy Tail alongside Gray Fullbuster and Erza Scarlet.

summary: Kazuma Satou and his growing party, useless goddess Aqua, one-spell explosion mage Megumin and masochist crusader Darkness, stumble through more adventures while struggling to earn money.

title: I Want to Eat Your Pancreas
summary: A detached bookworm finds the secret diary of his bubbly classmate Sakura Yamauchi and learns she has a terminal pancreatic illness. He agrees to spend her remaining days with her and slowly opens up.

title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Swordsmith Village Arc
summary: Tanjiro's journey takes him to the Swordsmith Village, where he reunites with Mist Hashira Muichiro Tokito and Love Hashira Mitsuri Kanroji as demons lurk nearby and a new battle begins.

title: Dororo
summary: Born without limbs or skin after his father Daigo Kagemitsu traded him to 12 demons for power, a boy hunts those demons to reclaim his body, joined by the orphan Dororo.

title: Assassination Classroom Second Season
summary: Back for the second semester, Class 3-E keeps aiming at Koro-sensei while old and new assassins chase his higher bounty, and Class A and the fearsome principal try to block their academic rise.

title: Hell’s Paradise
summary: Gabimaru the Hollow, a ninja on death row whom no execution can kill, is offered a full pardon by Asaemon the Decapitator if he joins an expedition to a mysterious island to find the elixir of life.

title: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion R2
summary: One year after the failed Black Rebellion, Lelouch lives as a student with no memory of being Zero, until C.C. sets out to wake his past so Zero can rise again and finish what he started.

title: Howl‘s Moving Castle
summary: Cursed into an old woman by the jealous Witch of the Waste, hatmaker's daughter Sophie joins the wizard Howl and his odd companions in his walking castle as war tears their kingdom apart.

title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Mugen Train Arc
summary: Tanjiro Kamado and fellow Demon Slayers board the Infinity Train to investigate mysterious disappearances caused by a demon that terrorizes passengers and kills the slayers who oppose it.

summary: Karasuno reaches the Spring tournament final against powerhouse Shiratorizawa Academy and its ace Wakatoshi Ushijima, with a ticket to nationals and the third-years' last chance on the line.

title: The Disastrous Life of Saiki K.
summary: Kusuo Saiki, a psychic with powers from telepathy to x-ray vision, only wants a quiet, ordinary life, but he keeps drawing in odd classmates like the empty-headed Riki Nendou and delusional Shun Kaidou.

summary: To save his friend at a demonic Sabbath party, gentle Akira Fudou merges with the devil Amon and becomes a Devilman, then fights alongside Ryou Asuka against the demons who harm humanity.

title: Hyouka
summary: Energy-saving student Houtarou Oreki joins the Classics Club at his sister's urging, and the curious Eru Chitanda pulls him into a 45-year-old mystery about the club and many small cases after it.

title: Fate/Zero
summary: Ten years before Fate/stay night, the Magus Killer Kiritsugu Emiya fights for the Einzbern family in the Fourth Holy Grail War with his familiar Saber, against six rivals and the priest Kirei Kotomine.

title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Stardust Crusaders
summary: When a Stand threatens to kill his mother Holly in 50 days, Joutarou Kuujou, his grandfather Joseph Joestar and their allies travel toward Cairo, Egypt, to destroy the immortal vampire responsible.

title: Monster
summary: Neurosurgeon Kenzou Tenma saves young Johan Liebert over the town's mayor and loses his standing, then nine years later faces the monster he saved and sets out to stop the havoc he spreads.

title: Bakemonogatari
summary: Koyomi Araragi, left with odd powers after a vampire attack, catches the strangely weightless Hitagi Senjougahara and, with help from Meme Oshino, starts helping people who suffer supernatural maladies.

title: The Apothecary Diaries
summary: Maomao, daughter of an apothecary, is sold as a servant to the emperor's palace, where she cures ailing imperial heirs, wins promotion from the official Jinshi, and starts solving medical mysteries.

title: Dr. STONE: STONE WARS
summary: As spring arrives, Senkuu and the Kingdom of Science launch their attack on the Tsukasa Empire, using a rebuilt cell phone to win over Tsukasa's army before it grows too large to stop.

title: Tower of God
summary: Twenty-Fifth Bam, a boy who knew only a dark cave until Rachel befriended him, follows her into the Tower and opens its gates by himself, becoming an Irregular among the chosen Regulars.

title: OSHI NO KO
summary: Doctor Gorou Amemiya is killed by a stalker on the eve of delivering idol Ai Hoshino's secret child, then is reborn as her son, Aquamarine Hoshino, inside the dark world of showbiz.

title: SPY x FAMILY Cour 2
summary: Loid races to stop Berlint University students plotting to kill Minister Brantz with bomb-carrying dogs, while Anya finds their base and befriends a clairvoyant dog the Forgers name Bond.

summary: Programmer Kobayashi drunkenly offers a dragon a place to stay, and the next morning Tooru turns up as an eager maid whose wild housework and mythical friends turn her quiet life upside down.

title: Seraph of the End: Vampire Reign
summary: After a virus kills everyone over 13 and vampires enslave the survivors, Yuuichirou alone escapes, and years later he joins the Japanese Imperial Demon Army to avenge his slaughtered family.

title: Wotakoi: Love is Hard for Otaku

title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Cour 2
summary: Teleported to the Demon Continent, Rudeus and Eris form the adventurer party Dead End with Ruijerd Supardia and journey home to Fittoa, while a power from Kishirika Kishirisu brings new dangers.

title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica
summary: Middle schoolers Madoka Kaname and Sayaka Miki are offered any wish by the familiar Kyuubey if they become magical girls, while transfer student Homura Akemi warns them nothing is what it seems.

title: The Quintessential Quintuplets

title: The Promised Neverland Season 2
summary: Out of Grace Field House, Emma, Ray and the older children flee through demon-filled wilderness, using coded messages in William Minerva's books to survive and search for a safe home.

title: The Eminence in Shadow

title: To Your Eternity

title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Diamond is Unbreakable

title: High School DxD
summary: Pervert Issei Hyoudou is killed on a date by a fallen angel, then revived by devil Rias Gremory as her servant and pulled into the Occult Research club and a violent world of angels and devils.

title: Solo Leveling Season 2 -Arise from the Shadow-
summary: Still mastering his new abilities in secret, Jin-U must now face and battle humanity's toughest foes, all for the one goal that drives him forward through every fight: saving his mother.

title: Fruits Basket (2019)
summary: Left alone after a family tragedy and living in a tent, Tooru Honda is taken in by the Souma family, then learns their secret: hugged by the opposite sex, they turn into Chinese Zodiac animals.

title: Noragami Aragoto
summary: Right after the first season, minor god Yato faces Bishamon, the god of war who holds a mysterious grudge against him, while her most trusted Regalia Kazuma seems to owe Yato a debt.

title: BANANA FISH
summary: Ash Lynx, a 17-year-old gang boss raised by mafia godfather Dino Golzine, digs into the words Banana Fish, and when Dino's men kidnap Japanese photographer Eiji Okumura, Ash must rescue him.

title: Rent-a-Girlfriend
summary: Dumped by his girlfriend, college student Kazuya Kinoshita hires rental girlfriend Chizuru Mizuhara, then tells his grandmother they are dating, forcing the furious Chizuru to keep up the act.

title: Tokyo Ghoul:re
summary: Two years after the raid on Anteiku, half-ghoul Haise Sasaki leads the CCG's Quinx Squad against Aogiri Tree, while lost memories slowly remind him of who he used to be.

title: GOBLIN SLAYER
summary: Saved from a deadly goblin ambush on her first quest, young Priestess joins the Goblin Slayer, a Silver-ranked warrior who, with High Elf, Dwarf and Lizard-man, hunts every goblin in the frontier.

title: Princess Mononoke
summary: Cursed by a demon boar, Prince Ashitaka travels west for a cure and reaches Iron Town, where Lady Eboshi's war on the forest pits her against Princess San and the forest spirits.

title: Fire Force Season 2
summary: Shinra Kusakabe vows to protect the pillars who hold Adolla Burst from the Evangelist, who plans to sacrifice all eight to recreate the Great Cataclysm, as the Special Fire Force goes to war.

title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Golden Wind
summary: In corrupt Naples, 15-year-old Giorno Giovanna, whose Stand Gold Experience creates life, joins Bruno Buccellati's team in the Passione gang while secretly plotting to overthrow its mysterious boss.

title: Clannad
summary: Bored delinquent Tomoya Okazaki befriends Nagisa Furukawa, a girl held back by illness who dreams of reviving the drama club, and in helping her and four other girls he finds life less dull.

title: The God of High School
summary: Taekwondo expert Jin Mo-Ri enters the God of High School tournament, where any method is allowed and the winner gets one wish, but a secret behind it draws politician Park Mu-Jin's hungry eye.

title: Gintama
summary: In a feudal Japan taken over by alien Amanto, sweets-loving samurai Gintoki Sakata runs odd jobs with Shinpachi, Kagura and giant dog Sadaharu, clashing with police, rebels and assassins.

title: HAIKYU!! TO THE TOP
summary: With nationals ahead, Kageyama joins the All-Japan Youth Training Camp and Tsukishima a rookie camp, so the uninvited Hinata sneaks into that camp as a ball boy and learns to read the court.

title: Durarara!!
summary: Mikado Ryuugamine moves to Ikebukuro, Tokyo, and on his first day sees the Black Rider, a headless urban legend on a jet-black motorcycle, as supernatural events pull the city's people together.

title: MASHLE: MAGIC AND MUSCLES
summary: In a world where everyone uses magic, Mash Burnedead cannot, so he trains his muscles, and after people try to kill him he enrolls in Magic School and aims to become a Divine Visionary.

title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Stardust Crusaders - Battle in Egypt
summary: Arriving in Egypt, Joutarou and his allies gain Iggy, a dog with the Stand The Fool, and face Dio's new Stand users based on Egyptian gods in a race to free Joutarou's mother from her curse.

title: Terror in Resonance
summary: Six months after a nuclear facility attack, two teens calling themselves Sphinx, Nine and Twelve, threaten Tokyo in online videos while Detective Kenjirou Shibazaki struggles to catch them.

title: Sword Art Online: Alicization
summary: Kazuto Kirigaya tests the Soul Translator for the institute Rath, then, after an old foe badly wounds him, wakes trapped inside its virtual Underworld and seeks a way back, haunted by the name Alice.

title: Maid-Sama!
summary: Misaki Ayuzawa, the strict first female student council president of a once all-boys school, hides a part-time maid café job, until popular boy Takumi Usui walks in and learns her secret.

title: High School of the Dead
summary: When the dead rise across Japan, Takashi Kimuro escapes his school with Rei Miyamoto, a group of students and their nurse, searching for their families and the cause of the outbreak.

title: Kuroko's Basketball
summary: At Seirin High, near-invisible passer Tetsuya Kuroko, once Teikou's Phantom Sixth Man, teams with Taiga Kagami to win the Interhigh and beat the Generation of Miracles, his former teammates.

title: Kaiju No. 8
summary: Kaiju-corpse cleaner Kafka Hibino gets another shot at his childhood dream of joining the Japan Defense Force, but an unexpected transformation turns him into a kaiju himself.

title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Revival of the Commandments
summary: After Meliodas fights Hendrickson, the Holy Knight breaks the seal on the Demon Clan and frees the Ten Commandments, the Demon King's mighty warriors, and the Sins must stop them ravaging Britannia.

title: Call of the Night
summary: Sleepless Kou Yamori wanders the streets every night until he meets Nazuna, who may be a vampire, and he must learn what it takes and how far he will go to become one himself.

title: WONDER EGG PRIORITY
summary: After her only friend Koito Nagase dies by suicide, Ai Ooto buys a Wonder Egg and breaks it in a dream world, where she saves people from their fears in hope of saving her friend.

title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Hashira Training Arc
summary: To prepare for the coming battle against Muzan Kibutsuji, the Hashira, the Demon Slayer Corps' strongest swordsmen, begin a special training, opening a new story for Tanjiro and the Hashira.

title: Saga of Tanya the Evil
summary: A man who defied Being X is reborn as Tanya Degurechaff, a girl soldier in a world of magical war, who ruthlessly climbs the military ranks and earns the name Devil of the Rhine.

title: My Neighbor Totoro
summary: In 1950s Japan, sisters Satsuki and Mei move to the countryside near their sick mother's hospital, and Mei chases a small creature into the forest, where she finds the giant forest spirit Totoro.

title: Samurai Champloo
summary: In an alternate Edo Japan, waitress Fuu Kasumi saves two feuding swordsmen, wild Mugen and precise ronin Jin, from execution and hires them to help her find the samurai who smells of sunflowers.

title: K-ON!
summary: Yui Hirasawa joins the Light Music Club thinking it means castanets, and when she tries to quit, the members, desperate to save the club, play a song for her that sparks her passion.

title: Beyond the Boundary
summary: Mirai Kuriyama, last of a clan of blood-wielding Spirit World warriors, stabs immortal half-youmu Akihito Kanbara, then keeps trying to kill him as they grow close and the youmu Beyond the Boundary nears.

title: Vinland Saga Season 2
summary: Enslaved and taken to Denmark after Danes kill his family, Einar works on landlord Ketil's farm to earn his freedom beside Thorfinn, a dejected slave haunted by the sins of his past.

title: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU TOO!
summary: Right after the first season, the Volunteer Service Club of Hachiman, Yui and Yukino keeps helping students, but a growing rift in the group shows Hachiman that his quick fixes cut both ways.

title: The Pet Girl of Sakurasou
summary: Sorata Kanda moves into Sakura Hall, a dorm of eccentric misfits, because of abandoned kittens, and plans to leave until artistic genius Mashiro Shiina transfers in and latches onto him.

title: Elfen Lied
summary: Lucy, a horned Diclonius with invisible telekinetic hands, kills her way out of a government lab and, left childlike by a head wound, is taken in by students Kouta and his cousin Yuka.

title: My Hero Academia Season 6
summary: With Shigaraki missing according to Hawks' intel, the Hero Association launches an all-out surprise attack on the Paranormal Liberation Front's headquarters, and the UA students head into battle again.

title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2
summary: Heartbroken after Eris leaves him, Rudeus heads to the Northern Territories to find his mother, until a brush with death on a quest with the party Counter Arrow pulls him out of despair.

title: BOCCHI THE ROCK!
summary: Painfully shy Hitori Gotou is learning guitar and dreams of joining a band, but she has no friends, until she meets drummer Nijika Ijichi, who is looking for a new guitarist.

title: The Misfit of Demon King Academy: History’s Strongest Demon King Reincarnates and Goes to School with His Descendants
summary: Demon King Anos Voldigoad reincarnates 2,000 years later, enrolls at the Demon King Academy, and is branded a misfit because history has given his name and deeds to an impostor.

title: Nisekoi
summary: Yakuza heir Raku Ichijou must fake a romance with Chitoge Kirisaki, daughter of the rival Bee Hive Gang's chief, to keep the peace, while he searches for the girl who holds the key to his pendant.

title: DON'T TOY WITH ME, MISS NAGATORO
summary: High schooler Hayase Nagatoro finds her timid Senpai's drawings and starts to tease him every day, until he realizes he does not mind her company and an uneasy friendship forms.

title: Overlord II
summary: Wary of the Slane Theocracy and other possible Yggdrasil players, Ainz Ooal Gown rules the Great Tomb of Nazarick as Albedo, Demiurge and his guardians prepare for Nazarick's first war.

title: JUJUTSU KAISEN Season 3: The Culling Game Part 1
summary: After Shibuya, Itadori skips Jujutsu High to hunt cursed spirits with Choso as Noritoshi Kamo's Culling Game spreads across ten colonies, and Yuta Okkotsu is named his executioner.

title: Golden Time
summary: After an accident wipes his memory, Banri Tada starts law school in Tokyo, befriends Mitsuo Yanagisawa, and has his new college life upended when the beautiful Kouko Kaga barges in.

title: Fullmetal Alchemist
summary: After a failed human transmutation costs Edward Elric two limbs and his brother Alphonse's body, the brothers hunt for the Philosopher's Stone and uncover a far darker battle behind it.

title: Mob Psycho 100 III
summary: A divine tree suddenly appears and a new religion rises around it, and together they turn the city where Mob and Reigen live completely upside down.

title: Fate/stay night: Unlimited Blade Works
summary: In the Fifth Holy Grail War, Rin Toosaka and her Servant Archer form an alliance with classmate Emiya Shirou, who accidentally joins the war as the Master of the Servant Saber.

title: Classroom of the Elite Season 2
summary: After the island survival test, Kiyotaka and Suzune of the underachiever class board a luxury liner to relax, only for a new test that scrambles the classes to begin.

title: Gachiakuta
summary: A boy from a floating town where the rich dump their trash into the abyss is falsely convicted of murder and thrown off the edge, landing on a surface where waste has bred monsters.

title: My Little Monster
summary: Grade-focused loner Shizuku Mizutani meets Haru Yoshida, a violent truant with no friends, who declares her his friend and confesses to her, and slowly the two learn what they feel.

title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dreaming Girl
summary: Sakuta's life with girlfriend Mai is shaken when his first crush Shouko returns as an adult, and he then meets a middle school Shouko in hospital with a grave illness tied to him.

title: Black Butler
summary: In Victorian England, young Ciel Phantomhive, the Queen's Guard Dog, solves dark cases with Sebastian Michaelis, a demon butler bound by a contract to take Ciel's soul in exchange for revenge.

title: ReLIFE
summary: Jobless 27-year-old Arata Kaizaki takes a pill from the ReLife Research Institute, wakes up looking 17, and must spend a year in high school as an experiment under observer Ryou Yoake.

title: Dragon Ball Z
summary: Five years after the tournament, Gokuu's peaceful life ends when Raditz arrives, claiming to be his brother, revealing Gokuu is a Saiyan and warning of a new threat headed for Earth.

title: The Irregular at Magic High School
summary: At First High School for magicians, Miyuki Shiba is placed with the elite Blooms while her brother Tatsuya is labeled a Weed, though he hides great skill, combat ability and unique magic.

title: Food Wars! The Second Plate
summary: With the Autumn Elections qualifiers over, the final eight chefs face off one-on-one in themed food wars, and Souma must handle new judges and rivals to reach the top.

title: Plastic Memories
summary: New hire Tsukasa Mizugaki joins SAI Corp's Terminal Service One, which retrieves Giftia androids before their lifespan ends, and is partnered with veteran Giftia Isla, whose own time is short.

title: Ouran High School Host Club
summary: Scholarship student Haruhi Fujioka breaks an eight million yen vase in Music Room #3 and must repay it by working for Tamaki Suou's Host Club, soon as a full-time male host.

title: BEASTARS
summary: After alpaca Tem is killed at Cherryton Academy, gray wolf Legoshi hides his fearsome side, until a night meeting with dwarf rabbit Haru stirs feelings tangled with his predator instincts.

title: HAIKYU!! TO THE TOP Part 2
summary: At nationals, Karasuno faces last Spring runner-up Inarizaki High, its loud crowd, and the Miya twins, Atsumu and Osamu, whose eccentric play stuns them despite a Hinata-centered attack.

title: Serial Experiments Lain
summary: Lain Iwakura, a shy fourteen-year-old who avoids technology, gets an email from Chisa Yomoda, a classmate who recently killed herself. It pulls her into the Wired, where reality and cyberspace start to blur.

title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: The End of Evangelion
summary: With the last Angel gone, Nerv faces its final enemy, the humans under Seele's command. A depressed Shinji Ikari must choose humanity's fate as Gendou Ikari and Rei Ayanami approach Lilith.

title: Black Lagoon
summary: Rokurou Okajima, a bored Japanese businessman, is kidnapped by the Black Lagoon mercenaries in the crime city of Roanapur. Abandoned by his employer, he joins them and must adapt to survive.

title: Kimi ni Todoke: From Me to You
summary: Sawako Kuronuma, a sweet girl nicknamed Sadako and feared by classmates, admires popular Shouta Kazehaya. When he invites her to a class test of courage, she starts making friends with Ayane Yano and Chizuru Yoshida.

title: 5 Centimeters per Second
summary: Childhood friends Takaki Toono and Akari Shinohara are pulled apart by circumstance. They promise to stay in touch, but time widens the distance, and both cling to the past and the hope of meeting again.

title: Deadman Wonderland
summary: Ganta Igarashi is framed for the massacre of his class by a mysterious man in red and sent to Deadman Wonderland, a prison amusement park. He must win its deadly games to survive and find the Red Man.

title: Prison School
summary: Five boys enroll at the formerly all-girls Hachimitsu Private Academy. Caught peeping into the girls' bath, Kiyoshi, Gakuto, Shingo, Andre and Jo are locked in the school prison by the Underground Student Council.

title: Date A Live
summary: Shidou Itsuka finds a Spirit, a being whose arrival causes spatial quakes, at the heart of a blast. His sister Kotori, commander of Ratatoskr, recruits him to stop the Spirits by making them fall in love with him.

title: The Garden of Words
summary: Takao Akizuki, a student who wants to make shoes, skips class to sketch in a Tokyo garden and meets the mysterious Yukari Yukino. They meet through the rainy season, easing each other's hidden worries.

title: TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You
summary: Top student Nasa Yuzaki is saved from a truck by a beautiful girl one snowy night. Bleeding, he chases her and asks her out, and she agrees on one condition: they can only be together if he marries her.

title: Overlord III
summary: Back at the Great Tomb of Nazarick, Ainz Ooal Gown and his Guardians put their plan of world domination into action. Carne Village prospers under threat, while the Bloody Emperor of the Baharuth Empire eyes Nazarick.

title: Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc
summary: Denji, now a devil hunter in Special Division 4, takes shelter from the rain after a date with Makima, the woman of his dreams. There he meets Reze, a girl who works in a café.

title: Chivalry of a Failed Knight
summary: Ikki Kurogane, the only F-rated Blazer at Hagun Academy, sees princess Stella Vermillion naked. She challenges him to a duel where the loser becomes the winner's slave, and he sets out to prove his strength.

title: Perfect Blue
summary: Mima Kirigoe leaves the idol group CHAM! to act in a crime drama. A stalker fan, a website that copies her life in detail and her draining new role push her until she cannot tell reality from fantasy.

title: The Ancient Magus' Bride
summary: Chise Hatori, an abandoned 15-year-old, is sold at auction to Elias Ainsworth, a masked magus. He takes her to his cottage in rural England, full of fairies, to become his apprentice and supposed bride.

title: Blue Spring Ride
summary: In middle school, Futaba Yoshioka lost Kou Tanaka, the only boy she liked, after a misunderstanding. Now a tomboyish high schooler, she meets him again, but he is now Kou Mabuchi and greatly changed.

title: Masamune-kun's Revenge
summary: Once mocked as Piggy by rich girl Aki Adagaki, a now handsome Masamune Makabe transfers to her school to make her fall for him and reject her. Then a mysterious letter calls him by his old nickname.

title: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? II
summary: Bell Cranel, now called Little Rookie as Orario's fastest-growing adventurer, keeps diving with Liliruca Arde and Welf Crozzo. Familias and gods across the city start trying to add him to their ranks.

title: KONOSUBA -God's blessing on this wonderful world!- Legend of Crimson
summary: A prank letter about a disaster sends Megumin, Yunyun and Kazuma's party to the Crimson Demons' village. While they sightsee in Megumin's birthplace, they learn the fake threat may be more than a joke.

title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead
summary: Akira, worn down by years at a soul-crushing company, finds new life when a zombie apocalypse hits his town. He sets out to complete all 100 items on his bucket list before he kicks the bucket.

title: Fate/Zero Season 2
summary: Risei Kotomine calls the Masters to unite against a threat to Fuyuki City, but the truce collapses. Kiritsugu Emiya and Saber clash over heroism, and Kirei Kotomine forms an ominous bond with a Servant.

title: Guilty Crown
summary: In 2039 Japan, ruled by the GHQ after the Apocalypse Virus, Shuu Ouma meets Inori Yuzuriha of the rebel group Funeral Parlor. He gains the Power of Kings, which draws out people's voids, and joins the fight.

title: Nichijou - My Ordinary Life
summary: Friends Mio Naganohara, Yuuko Aioi and Mai Minakami cross paths with the child genius Hakase, her robot Nano and their talking cat Sakamoto, in a daily life where the principal can suplex a deer.

title: SPY x FAMILY Season 2
summary: The Forger family takes on a new family mission, and Yor sets off on an expedition aboard a cruise ship, taking the story out to sea for a new adventure.

title: Toilet-bound Hanako-kun
summary: At Kamome Academy, Nene Yashiro summons the wish-granting ghost Hanako-san for luck in love and finds he is a boy. She becomes Hanako-kun's assistant, helping keep the balance between mortals and apparitions.

title: Bungo Stray Dogs 2
summary: In the past, Port Mafia's Osamu Dazai, Sakunosuke Oda and agent Angou Sakaguchi meet at Lupin Bar until Angou vanishes. Now, the Agency faces the Guild, an American group after its permit, and the Port Mafia.

title: Tokyo Ghoul:re 2
summary: After the Tsukiyama Family Extermination Operation, Haise Sasaki quits Quinx Squad and coldly takes any CCG task as Ken Kaneki's memories return. Quinx mourns a member, and hints of a group behind the CCG surface.

title: Log Horizon
summary: Thirty thousand Japanese gamers are trapped in the MMORPG Elder Tale after an update. Veteran strategist Shiroe, with Naotsugu and the assassin Akatsuki, works to bring order to the city of Akihabara.

title: Grand Blue Dreaming
summary: Iori Kitahara moves to Izu for college and lives above his uncle's dive shop, Grand Blue. Upperclassmen Shinji Tokita and Ryuujirou Kotobuki drag him into the Diving Club's wild drinking, earning cousin Chisa's disdain.

title: Kakegurui xx
summary: Kirari Momobami calls a student council election: each student gets one chip, and whoever holds the most after thirty days leads the school and the Momobami clan. Eleven branch family transfer students join the race.

title: Orange
summary: On her first day of sophomore year, Naho Takamiya gets a letter from herself 10 years in the future. It lists her regrets and warns her to watch over transfer student Kakeru Naruse, who is gone in that future.

title: Dragon Ball
summary: Young Gokuu Son, living alone in the woods, joins Bulma on her hunt for the seven wish-granting Dragon Balls. Along the way he trains with Muten-Roshi and Kuririn for the World Martial Arts Tournament.

title: The Quintessential Quintuplets 2
summary: Tutor Fuutarou Uesugi gets drawn deeper into the Nakano quintuplets' personal lives as their grades slowly improve. He also starts to sense a link between one of the five girls and his own past.

title: SK8 the Infinity
summary: Skater Reki Kyan, his board smashed and arm broken at the underground race S, meets new classmate Langa Hasegawa, who has never skated. A bet forces Langa into a race, and he holds a trump card Reki does not know about.

title: Witch Hat Atelier
summary: Coco dreams of being a witch, but everyone knows magicians are born, not made. After secretly watching the traveling magician Qifrey cast a spell, she learns that what everybody knows might not be true.

title: Danganronpa: The Animation
summary: Makoto Naegi, an ordinary boy admitted to elite Hope's Peak Academy as Super High School-Level Luck, is trapped inside with his classmates by Monokuma. The only way out is to murder a peer and not get caught.

title: Akira
summary: In 2019 Neo-Tokyo, Shoutarou Kaneda leads the biker gang the Capsules. When his best friend Tetsuo Shima crashes into an escaped esper, Tetsuo starts to develop powers the government fears could destroy the city.

title: Magi: The Labyrinth of Magic
summary: Aladdin, a young magician who has lived in isolation, sets out with Ugo, the djinn in his flute. After wrecking a merchant's cart, he befriends Alibaba Saluja, and they set out to conquer a treasure-filled Dungeon.

title: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest
summary: Summoned to a fantasy world with his class, otaku Hajime Nagumo gets only a weak transmutation skill. Betrayed and dropped into the abyss of the Great Orcus Labyrinth, he fights to survive and meets the vampire Yue.

title: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Season 2
summary: After the First-Class Mage Exam, Frieren, Stark and Fern cross the dangerous Northern Plateau toward Aureole. Hard foes push Stark to own his role as frontliner, while Frieren recalls the Hero's party and wonders if she has changed.

title: Yuri!!! on ICE
summary: After a crushing loss at the Grand Prix Finale, skater Yuuri Katsuki, 23, goes home. A viral video of him skating a Victor Nikiforov routine brings Victor to his door as coach, and Russian rival Yuri Plisetsky wants him back.

title: Great Pretender
summary: Small-time scammer Makoto Edamura is conned by Laurent Thierry, the tourist he tried to swindle, and follows him to Los Angeles. To prove he is Japan's greatest swindler, he joins a con on the West Coast's biggest mafia boss.

title: DAN DA DAN Season 2
summary: The exorcism of Jiji's family home goes wrong. Momo Ayase dodges an abduction while Okarun and Jiji are ambushed by the Kitou family, the eerie landlords of the cursed estate, in a town full of legends.

title: Blood Blockade Battlefront
summary: In Hellsalem's Lot, once New York and now sealed in a bubble with creatures from the Beyond, Leonardo Watch arrives with the All-seeing Eyes of the Gods, gained at the cost of his sister's sight, and joins the secret group Libra.

title: No Game, No Life Zero
summary: In ancient Disboard, young warrior Riku fights to save humanity from extinction amid the war of the Exceed. In an abandoned elf city he finds Schwi, an exiled Ex-machina who studies human emotions, and they team up.

title: Delicious in Dungeon
summary: A dragon deep in a dungeon routs Laios and his party, taking their money, supplies and one member. To rescue her without starving on the way back down, Laios has an idea: eat the monsters.

title: Summer Time Rendering
summary: Shinpei Ajiro returns to his home island to mourn Ushio Kofune, who drowned saving a girl. Bruises on her neck, dangerous beings among the islanders and Ushio's vision asking him to save Mio point to something more.

title: Food Wars! The Third Plate
summary: Souma Yukihira uses the Moon Festival, Tootsuki Academy's profit-driven food fair, to challenge the Elite Ten for the first time, while a plot brews that will shake the academy to its foundations.

title: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax!
summary: Iroha Isshiki asks the Volunteer Service Club to help hold a graduation prom. Yukino Yukinoshita takes it on to prove her independence to her parents, as Hachiman Hikigaya's high school life nears its end.

title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
summary: In a peaceful, high-tech Konohagakure, Boruto Uzumaki, the gifted but arrogant son of Seventh Hokage Naruto, resents his busy father and wants to surpass him, while a sinister force grows in the village.

title: Ranking of Kings
summary: Bojji, a deaf, powerless prince mocked as unfit to rule, dreams of becoming the world's greatest king. His journey begins when he makes his first friend, Kage, a living shadow and survivor of an assassin clan.

title: SAKAMOTO DAYS
summary: Legendary hit man Sakamoto retires after falling for store clerk Aoi, then marries, has a daughter and runs a small shop. To protect his family's peace, he teams up with comrades against the assassins who come for him.

title: Clannad: After Story
summary: After graduating, Tomoya Okazaki and Nagisa Furukawa face growing up together as Tomoya learns to work hard and lean on Nagisa. In the Illusionary World, winter comes and reveals the World's true purpose.

title: Domestic Girlfriend
summary: Natsuo Fujii loves his teacher Hina and shares a one-night first time with Rui, a girl from a mixer. Then his father remarries, and his new stepsisters turn out to be Hina and Rui Tachibana.

title: Steins;Gate 0
summary: Broken after failing to save Makise Kurisu, Rintarou Okabe lives as an ordinary student. Then Maho Hiyajo and Alexis Leskinen unveil Amadeus, an AI holding Kurisu's memories, and hire him to study it.

title: Monthly Girls' Nozaki-kun
summary: When Chiyo Sakura confesses to Umetarou Nozaki, he gives her an autograph, since he is secretly the shoujo mangaka Sakiko Yumeno. She ends up as his assistant, hoping he will one day notice her feelings.

title: My Hero Academia: Two Heroes
summary: On summer break, Izuku Midoriya joins All Might at a hero festival on I-Island and meets engineers Dave and Melissa. When villains take over the island, Midoriya and his classmates must fight them and uncover a plot.

title: Sword Art Online: Alicization - War of Underworld
summary: A raid on the Ocean Turtle damages Kirito's fluctlight and leaves him in a coma. Alice cares for him near Rulid Village, until the Dark Territory invades the Human Empire and she returns as Alice Synthesis Thirty to fight.

title: Dragon Ball Super
summary: Seven years after Dragon Ball Z, Earth's peace ends when Beerus, the God of Destruction, wakes. Troubled by a prophecy of a Super Saiyan God, he and his attendant Whis search the universe and reach Gokuu Son.

title: Angels of Death
summary: Rachel Gardner, who wishes only to die, wakes in a building's basement and meets Zack, a bandaged killer. He promises to kill her once he is free, and they climb floor by floor past twisted bosses who know her.

title: Yona of the Dawn
summary: When the king is murdered and her beloved cousin Su-won betrays her, sheltered Princess Yona flees with her bodyguard Son Hak. Outside the palace she finds Kouka full of poverty and corruption, as the new king hunts her.

title: Shikimori's Not Just a Cutie
summary: Shikimori seems like the perfect girlfriend, cute, fun and sweet, but she has a cool dark side that comes out under the right conditions, and her boyfriend Izumi loves being there when it does.

title: The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity
summary: Rintarou, a fierce-faced but gentle boy from low-ranked Chidori High, hits it off with Kaoruko at his family's patisserie. Then he learns she attends Kikyo Girls' High, the elite school next door.

title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 Part 2
summary: Rudeus Greyrat and his childhood friend Sylphiette hold a wedding party at the University of Magic. Then Shizuka Nanahoshi's research stalls and sinks her into a slump, and a letter from his father Paul strains things.

title: Tengoku Daimakyo
summary: In 2024, Japan lies in ruins, with grotesque monsters lurking among the wreckage. Kiruko, an odd-job girl in Nakano, takes on a dying woman's wish to bring a boy named Maru to a place called Heaven.

title: March comes in like a lion
summary: Rei Kiriyama, a 17-year-old shogi pro since middle school, lives alone and lonely in Tokyo. The Kawamoto sisters, Akari, Hinata and Momo, take him in with motherly care and a family bond he has long lacked.

title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 2
summary: Back at her duties for the emperor's top consorts, Maomao helps Jinshi teach the ladies-in-waiting to read. When a merchant caravan arrives, strange coincidences around its visitors and wares drive her to investigate.

title: Lycoris Recoil
summary: LycoReco, a Japanese-style café in downtown Tokyo, serves coffee and sweets but also takes odd jobs, from night deliveries to monster extermination, run by a smiling poster girl, a serious newcomer and their crew.

title: The Case Study of Vanitas
summary: In 19th-century Paris, young vampire Noé hunts for the Book of Vanitas. A human doctor who calls himself Vanitas saves him from a maddened vampire, heals it, and invites Noé on a crusade to cure all vampires.

title: given
summary: High schooler Mafuyu Satou asks Ritsuka Uenoyama to fix his broken Gibson and teach him guitar. Stunned by Satou's voice, Uenoyama wants him as lead singer of his band with Haruki Nakayama and Akihiko Kaji.

title: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War
summary: As Hollows vanish and Rukon District residents go missing, the Wandenreich, led by Quincy father Yhwach, attacks the Seireitei and vows to wipe out the Soul Society in five days. Ichigo Kurosaki returns to fight.

title: Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian
summary: Alya, a popular, cold transfer student with top grades, ignores nerdy classmate Kuze Masachika except to blurt flirty lines at him in Russian. She has no idea Kuze understands Russian and only pretends not to.

title: NANA
summary: Two 20-year-olds named Nana board the same train to Tokyo: naive Nana Komatsu, chasing her boyfriend Shouji, and proud punk singer Nana Osaki, chasing a music career. A chance meeting leads them to share an apartment.

title: My Love Story with Yamada-kun at Lv999
summary: After her boyfriend cheats with a woman from an online game, college student Akane Kinoshita vents to Yamada, a guildmate who replies that he does not care. At an offline event to spite her ex, she meets him in person.

title: SHIMONETA: A Boring World Where the Concept of Dirty Jokes Doesn’t Exist
summary: In a Japan where neck devices enforce strict morality laws, Tanukichi Okuma joins the student council to get near his crush Anna Nishikinomiya. Vice president Ayame Kajou, secretly the outlaw Blue Snow, drags him into SOX.

title: FLCL
summary: Sixth grader Naota Nandaba looks after what his brother Tasuku left behind, including ex-girlfriend Mamimi. Then Haruko Haruhara, a Vespa-riding bassist, runs him over, leaves a horn on his head and moves into his home.

title: How NOT to Summon a Demon Lord
summary: Shut-in gamer Takuma Sakamoto is summoned into a world like Cross Reverie, looking like his Demon King avatar Diablo. Rem Galeu and Shera L. Greenwood try to enslave him, but the ritual backfires and makes them his slaves.

title: The World's Finest Assassin Gets Reincarnated in Another World as an Aristocrat
summary: Earth's greatest assassin, discarded by his employers, is reborn by a goddess into a world of swords and sorcery as Lugh Tuatha Dé. His mission is to kill a powerful hero who will end the world unless stopped.

title: Welcome to the N-H-K
summary: Tatsuhiro Satou, a 22-year-old college dropout and shut-in for four years, believes a secret group called the NHK caused his isolation. Then he meets the mysterious Misaki Nakahara, who may change his luck.

title: Fate/stay night: Unlimited Blade Works 2nd Season
summary: Caster captures Shirou's Servant Saber, and as Rin and Archer move against the growing witch, the pair start to part ways. Without a Servant and hurt, Shirou ignores Rin's warning and forces his way into the fight against Caster.

title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle
summary: During the Hashira Training, Muzan Kibutsuji appears at the Ubuyashiki Mansion. Tanjiro and the Hashira rush to save the Corps' leader but are dropped into the Infinity Castle, where the final battle against the demons begins.

title: Grave of the Fireflies
summary: In 1945, as American bombs devastate Japan, siblings Seita and Setsuko lose their mother, father and home. Orphaned, they drift through the countryside, facing hunger, disease and the indifference of adults.

title: Dr. STONE New World
summary: Senkuu and the Kingdom of Science set sail from their home shores for new lands, on a voyage to uncover more scientific secrets than they have found so far.

title: Suzume
summary: In a quiet Kyushu town, 17-year-old Suzume meets a young man looking for a door and opens one in mountain ruins. More doors start opening across Japan, letting disasters through, and she sets out to close them.

title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Imperial Wrath of the Gods
summary: With Liones saved, Meliodas and the Seven Deadly Sins face trials to grow strong enough to beat the 10 Commandments and overcome past trauma, uncovering truths about each other and a plan begun ten thousand years ago.

title: Kiznaiver
summary: Katsuhira Agata, a boy who barely feels pain or emotion, is abducted with his friend Chidori Takashiro and four other teens into the Kizuna System. As Kiznaivers, they share each other's pain in the name of world peace.

title: Violet Evergarden: the Movie
summary: Violet still cannot forget Gilbert, the man who taught her about love, even when his older brother Dietfried tells her to move on. Then a young client calls, and the post office finds a letter with no address.

title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 3
summary: A year after Subaru's win at the Sanctuary, royal candidate Anastasia invites Emilia to the Watergate City of Priestella. As the party travels there, a crisis stirs and Subaru meets a cruel fate again.

title: Cells at Work!
summary: Inside a human body of 37.2 trillion cells, new red blood cell AE3803 delivers oxygen and often gets lost, while white blood cell U-1146 hunts bacteria and the platelets fix wounds.

title: Akashic Records of Bastard Magic Instructor
summary: At Alzano Imperial Magic Academy, stern noble Sistine Fibel and her friend Rumia Tingel get a lazy new teacher, Glenn Radars, who clashes with the class. Soon dark forces in the empire pull all three into their schemes.

title: Cautious Hero: The Hero Is Overpowered but Overly Cautious
summary: Summoned by the goddess Ristarte to save Gaeabrande, the overpowered hero Seiya Ryuuguuin trains endlessly, buys far too many potions and uses his strongest skills on weak foes, all to stay safe.

title: The Melancholy of Haruhi Suzumiya
summary: Kyon, a high schooler who gave up on the supernatural, meets Haruhi Suzumiya, who craves aliens, time travelers and espers. She forms the SOS Brigade and drafts Kyon, Yuki Nagato, Mikuru Asahina and Itsuki Koizumi.

title: 86 EIGHTY-SIX Part 2
summary: After parting from Lena, Shin and the Spearhead survivors cross Legion territory and are rescued by the Federal Republic of Giad. Offered peace, they enlist and return to the front, joined by the gifted young Frederica Rosenfort.

title: 91 Days
summary: Seven years after the Vanetti mafia killed his family, Angelo Lagusa, now Avilio Bruno, gets a letter calling him back to Lawless. In the Prohibition era he befriends the don's son, Nero, to take his revenge.

title: The Eminence in Shadow Season 2
summary: Cid Kagenou and Shadow Garden investigate the Lawless City, ruled by three monarchs under a low red moon. Cid's true interest is the Blood Queen, a vampire who has slept in her coffin for eons and will soon wake.

title: Gate
summary: When a gate in Ginza unleashes monsters and armored warriors, off-duty JSDF officer and otaku Youji Itami saves many lives. Three months later he leads a recon team into the Special Region beyond, to make peace with its empire.

title: TRINITY SEVEN
summary: After the Breakdown Phenomenon destroys his town and takes his cousin Hijiri, Arata Kasuga enrolls at the secret magic school Royal Biblia Academy, home of the elite mages called the Trinity Seven, to save her.

title: Seraph of the End: Battle in Nagoya
summary: Yuuichirou Hyakuya learns his childhood friend Mikaela is now a vampire. As vampires gather in Nagoya to attack Tokyo, Guren Ichinose sends Shinoa squad to hunt the vampire nobles, while Yuu fights the demon of his Cursed Gear.

title: Bungo Stray Dogs 3
summary: Years ago, new Port Mafia recruit Osamu Dazai teams up with Chuuya Nakahara of the Sheep to probe a mysterious explosion and the myth of Arahabaki. In the present, old and new enemies gather against the Armed Detective Agency.

title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress
summary: On the island of Hinomoto, humans hide behind walls from the undead Kabane, reached only by armored trains. Young train builder Ikoma has made a weapon to pierce their steel hearts, and his chance to use it comes sooner than expected.

title: High School DxD NEW
summary: Knight Yuuto Kiba of the Occult Research Club seeks revenge for the cruel Holy Sword experiment of his past. An old enemy returns and two Holy Sword wielders appear, pulling Issei Hyoudou and his Devil comrades into a new plot.

title: Sword Art Online: Alicization - War of Underworld Part 2
summary: Players from around the world flood the Underworld as the war with the Dark Territory drags on. Asuna defends her allies, Alice Zuberg flees Gabriel Miller toward the World's End Altar, and Rath races to restore Kirito's fluctlight.

title: Tsuredure Children
summary: A string of scenarios follows young people through first love, from those who cannot bring themselves to confess to those who do not know what real love feels like, with all of its struggles and joys.

title: My Dress-Up Darling Season 2
summary: Marin Kitagawa and Wakana Gojo's world keeps growing as they make new cosplay friends and get closer to classmates, while Marin's love for Wakana brings new developments and endless excitement.

title: Black Bullet
summary: In 2021, the Gastrea virus turns humans into monsters, and mankind lives inside Varanium Monolith walls. Promoter Satomi Rentaro and his Initiator Enju Aihara, a Cursed Child with superhuman powers, fight the Gastrea in Tokyo.

title: Sword Art Online the Movie: Ordinal Scale
summary: In 2026, the safe augmented reality device Augma is a hit, and its game Ordinal Scale offers rankings and rewards. Kirito joins his friends in it despite his doubts, and they soon find the game is not all it seems.

title: Into the Forest of Fireflies' Light
summary: Lost in a forest while visiting her uncle, six-year-old Hotaru Takegawa is led out by Gin, a masked spirit who will vanish if a human touches him. She visits him every summer, until romantic feelings clash with that one rule.

title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: STONE OCEAN
summary: In Florida, 2011, Jolyne Kuujou is framed and jailed at Green Dolphin Street Jail. A gift from her father Joutarou awakens her Stand, Stone Free, and she uncovers a plot against her family led by a mastermind inside the prison.

title: MUSHI-SHI
summary: Mushi are the most basic forms of life, unseen by most humans and able to mimic plants, diseases and even rainbows. Ginko, a Mushishi, chases rumors of Mushi occurrences in search of why they exist.

title: Wolf Children
summary: College student Hana falls for the last living werewolf and has two children, Ame and Yuki, who can turn into wolves. After his sudden death, she raises them alone and moves to the countryside to keep their secret.

title: Daily Lives of High School Boys
summary: At the all-boys Sanada North High School, Hidenori, Yoshitake and Tadakuni pass the time with wild imaginations, turning ordinary days into RPG reenactments and riverbank romance that are bizarre yet relatable.

title: WIND BREAKER
summary: First-year Haruka Sakura comes to Furin High School, a school of delinquents, to fight his way to the top. He finds that Furin has become Bofurin, a group that protects the town, and his legend begins there.

title: Shangri-La Frontier
summary: In a near future ruled by VR games, Rakuro Hizutome is a crap-game hunter who clears broken titles. His next target is Shangri-La Frontier, a god-tier game with thirty million players, rivals and a vast world to explore.

title: A Whisker Away
summary: High school girl Miyo Sasaki, fleeing problems at home, can only get her crush Kento Hinode's attention as a white cat he calls Tarou. Unable to help him in cat form, she must choose whether to reveal who she is.

title: Dorohedoro
summary: In Hole, a lawless district where magic users experiment on the powerless, Kaiman, more reptile than man and immune to magic, hunts them with his bayonets for answers, with Nikaidou of the Hungry Bug restaurant at his side.

title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 3
summary: Now a Demon Lord ruling the whole Great Forest of Jura, Rimuru plans a festival to open Tempest to the world. Then a forged declaration of war sends Holy Knight Captain Hinata of Lubelius heading for Tempest.

title: Classroom of the Elite Season 3
summary: The third semester opens with a boot camp deep in the mountains, where students of every grade are split into groups by grade and gender. The leader of the last-place group will be expelled, putting Class D at risk.

title: A Certain Magical Index
summary: In Academy City, a hub of espers, level-zero Touma Kamijou has Imagine Breaker, which negates supernatural powers. He meets Index, a girl who has memorized forbidden grimoires, and vows to protect her from the magicians hunting her.

title: Haven't You Heard? I'm Sakamoto
summary: From his first day of high school, the handsome and flawless Sakamoto has girls swooning and boys fuming with jealousy. Every attempt to trip him up fails, though the classmates and teachers who try might learn something.

title: Kokoro Connect
summary: Five Yamaboshi Academy students form the Student Cultural Society, until they begin switching bodies at random. Forced closer than ever, Taichi, Iori, Himeko, Yui and Aoki uncover each other's secrets and emotional scars.

title: The Disastrous Life of Saiki K. Season 2
summary: Psychic Kusuo Saiki keeps trying to live an ordinary life while his troublesome friends get in the way. A few new faces join the usual oddballs, and their antics push his dream of a peaceful life even further off.

title: Baccano!
summary: In 1930s America, the train Flying Pussyfoot starts a bloody journey, scientist Szilard hunts lost bottles of an immortality elixir, and mafia groups go to war. Would-be thieves Isaac and Miria tie these stories together.

title: Yamada and the Seven Witches
summary: Delinquent Ryuu Yamada tumbles down the stairs with honors student Urara Shiraishi and learns they swap bodies with a kiss. Joining the Supernatural Studies Club, they set out to find the Seven Witches of Suzaku High.

title: Fate/stay night
summary: Years after his foster father Kiritsugu Emiya dies, Shirou is caught in a fight between Servants and summons his own, the knight Saber. Together they enter the Fifth Holy Grail War, a battle royale for the omnipotent Holy Grail.

title: Ponyo
summary: A goldfish freed by five-year-old Sousuke is named Ponyo and decides to become human, growing arms and legs with power from his blood. Her magic throws nature off balance, and Sousuke must pass an ancient test to restore order.

title: My Hero Academia Season 7
summary: After the war with the Paranormal Liberation Front, All Might calls in Star and Stripe, the strongest woman on the planet. All For One moves to intercept her fleet and steal her quirk before she can reach Japan.

title: Higehiro: After Being Rejected, I Shaved and Took in a High School Runaway
summary: Rejected by his crush, office worker Yoshida finds runaway high school girl Sayu Ogiwara by the road and lets her stay. Instead of accepting her advances, he has her do housework, and an unlikely bond begins.

title: Josee, the Tiger and the Fish
summary: College student Tsuneo meets Josee, a dreamer in a wheelchair who spends her days reading and painting. Their chance encounter pushes Josee to decide that it is finally time to face the real world.

title: Kiki's Delivery Service
summary: Thirteen-year-old witch Kiki must live alone for a year to finish her training, so she flies with her cat Jiji to the coastal town of Koriko. Boarding with baker Osono, she starts a courier service by broomstick.

title: Hellsing Ultimate
summary: Integra Hellsing leads an organization that destroys the undead, and her ultimate weapon is the vampire Alucard. With his new vampire servant Seras Victoria, Alucard battles monsters and anyone else who opposes Hellsing.

title: Berserk
summary: Mercenary Guts lives from one battle to the next until Griffith, the White Hawk, recruits him into the Band of the Hawk. As they take Midland by storm, Guts begins to see the world is not as black and white as he thought.

title: Eromanga Sensei
summary: Light novel author Masamune Izumi cares for his shut-in stepsister Sagiri after their parents die, then learns she is his lewd illustrator, Eromanga-sensei. Together they face the light novel industry.

title: Fruits Basket Season 2
summary: A year after moving in with the Soumas, Tooru Honda spends summer with Kyou and Yuki as old pains resurface. The zodiac prepares for the Eternal Banquet under family head Akito, and Tooru sees their secret is darker than she thought.

title: Nisemonogatari
summary: Koyomi Araragi wakes up kidnapped by his girlfriend Hitagi Senjougahara, who wants to protect him from con man Deishuu Kaiki. The swindler soon targets his sister Karen, while his other sister Tsukihi has troubles of her own.

title: Fairy Tail Series 2
summary: The Grand Magic Games reach their climax after Natsu and Gajeel defeat Sting and Rogue of Sabertooth, pushing Fairy Tail toward the title. A hooded stranger and the ominous Eclipse Gate still hide a mystery.

title: Wise Man’s Grandchild
summary: Reincarnated from Japan and raised in the woods by hero Merlin Walford, Shin shows unmatched talent in magic and martial arts but no common sense. At 15 he enrolls in Earlshide's Magic Academy and becomes an instant celebrity.

title: MASHLE: MAGIC AND MUSCLES Season 2
summary: With his secret out, Mash Burnedead is sentenced to death by the Divine Visionaries. Rayne Ames and Headmaster Wahlberg win him a reprieve until Innocent Zero falls, if he becomes the Divine Visionary candidate by year's end.

title: Grimgar of Fantasy and Ash
summary: Strangers wake in Grimgar with only their names and must join the Reserve Army. Left behind by the strong, Manato, Haruhiro, Yume, Shihoru, Mogzo and Ranta form a party in a game-like world with no respawns.

title: Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions - Heart Throb -
summary: Yuuta Togashi and Rikka Takanashi now live together, but their relationship stays stuck as a new school year starts. Then Satone Shichimiya, another chuuni girl from Yuuta's middle school, appears.

title: BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense.
summary: Novice Kaede Honjou puts every stat point into vitality in the VRMMO New World Online. Her character Maple can barely move or hit, yet her defense earns overpowered skills and third place in a server-wide event within days.

title: Kuroko's Basketball 2
summary: After the Interhigh, Seirin trains for the Winter Cup as old friends return for Kuroko and Kagami. Giants Yousen, Shuutoku and Touou and the Uncrowned Kings stand between Seirin and the Generation of Miracles.

title: Free! -Iwatobi Swim Club-
summary: Years after winning an elementary relay together, Haruka Nanase reunites with Rin Matsuoka, who now only wants to beat him. Haruka, Nagisa and Makoto form the Iwatobi Swim Club and recruit Rei Ryuugazaki as their fourth.

title: Scum's Wish
summary: Hanabi Yasuraoka loves her teacher Narumi, and Mugi Awaya loves music teacher Akane, who is falling for Narumi. Seen as a perfect couple, the two use each other as stand-ins to stave off their loneliness.

title: Snow White with the Red Hair
summary: Apothecary Shirayuki cuts her red hair and flees Prince Raji of Tanbarun, who wants her as his concubine. Rescued by Zen Wistalia, second prince of Clarines, she sets out to become a court herbalist in his country.

title: Spice and Wolf
summary: Holo, a wolf deity reduced to a folk tale in the town of Pasloe, offers to partner with traveling merchant Kraft Lawrence if he takes her north to Yoitsu. Together they roam the countryside in search of profit.

title: KONOSUBA -God's blessing on this wonderful world! 3
summary: Disillusioned with adventure, Kazuma wants to quit and become a monk, but Aqua, Megumin and Darkness object. The dispute goes on hold when a princess asks to hear their tales, bringing the party to the royal castle.

title: Vivy -Fluorite Eye's Song-
summary: Vivy, the world's first autonomous humanoid AI, meets an AI named Matsumoto. His mission is to rewrite history together with her to stop a war between AI and humans that will break out one century later.

title: BLEND-S
summary: Sixteen-year-old Maika Sakuranomiya keeps failing interviews because her smile looks menacing. At Café Stile, where servers play roles, manager Dino hires her as a sadistic waitress beside tsundere Kaho and little sister Mafuyu.

title: OSHI NO KO Season 2
summary: While Ruby follows their slain mother's path as an idol, Aqua joins a famous theater troupe to find clues to his father, the man who arranged their mother's death and once starred in that same troupe.

title: Wistoria: Wand and Sword
summary: Will enters a magic academy to become a great sorcerer, but he cannot use magic at all. Facing cold stares from classmates and instructors, he fights with a sword instead, driven by a promise to someone precious.

title: Overlord IV
summary: E-Rantel, capital of the new Sorcerer Kingdom, runs short of goods, so Ainz sends Albedo as envoy. Emperor Jircniv meets Slane Theocracy messengers at a colosseum, only to face Ainz, who challenges the Warrior King to a duel.

title: Tomo-chan Is a Girl!
summary: Tomboy Tomo has a high school crush on her childhood friend Junichiro, but he only sees her as one of the guys. No matter her pretty looks or her signals, nothing gets through to him.

title: Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend
summary: Otaku Tomoya Aki wants to make his own visual novel and recruits illustrator Eriri Spencer Sawamura and writer Utaha Kasumigaoka. He models his heroine on Megumi Katou, a docile girl he meets, and forms a doujin circle.

title: Blue Exorcist: Kyoto Saga
summary: The left eye of the Impure King is stolen from True Cross Academy, and Rin and the ExWires go to Kyoto after a try for the right eye. Distant from his peers as Satan's son, Rin trains to control his power as fears of a traitor grow.

title: From the New World
summary: In Kamisu 66, 12-year-old Saki Watanabe awakens to her psychic powers and joins her friends at Sage Academy. She starts to question what happens to those who never awaken, as rumors of child-stealing Tainted Cats spread.

title: When They Cry
summary: In summer 1983, Keiichi Maebara moves to Hinamizawa and befriends Rena, Mion, Satoko and Rika. He learns of murders and disappearances tied to the village festival and the god Oyashiro, and paranoia takes root.

title: Hell’s Paradise Season 2
summary: Seeking the elixir of immortality, criminals and executioners must work together at the fortress of the Tensen. The shogunate lands more forces led by Shugen, including the Ishigakure clan from Gabimaru's past.

title: High School DxD BorN
summary: Over summer break, Rias Gremory and Azazel take the Occult Research Club to train in the Underworld after their fight with Vali and the Chaos Brigade. Their foes grow stronger, and Loki, the Norse Evil God, appears.

title: Link Click
summary: Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang run Time Photo Studio, a small shop that looks abandoned. To fulfil customer requests, they use their special abilities to enter photos, but things do not go as planned.

title: Ghost in the Shell
summary: In 2029 Niihama City, Major Motoko Kusanagi of Public Security Section 9 hunts the Puppet Master, a hacker who leaves victims stripped of their memories. As Section 6 steps in, the case pushes her to question her own life.

title: Darker than Black
summary: Ten years after Heaven's Gate and Hell's Gate appeared, Contractors trade their humanity for powers. In the city by Hell's Gate, Contractor Hei, the Black Reaper, works for the Syndicate while clashing with Section 4 Chief Misaki Kirihara.

title: The Angel Next Door Spoils Me Rotten
summary: Amane lives alone, and Mahiru, the most beautiful girl in school, lives next door. After he lends her his umbrella on a rainy day, she repays him with help around the house, and a slow romance begins.

title: GTO: Great Teacher Onizuka
summary: Ex-biker gang leader Eikichi Onizuka becomes homeroom teacher of Class 3-4 at Holy Forest Academy, a class that breaks every teacher. With unconventional methods, he tackles the bullying and other problems his students face.

title: Food Wars! The Fourth Plate
summary: The Régiment de Cuisine rages on as Souma Yukihira and Erina Nakiri lead the rebels against Central. After a perfect first bout, they must face the rest of the Elite Ten Council with Tootsuki's future at stake.

title: TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy-
summary: High school student Misumi Makoto is called into a fantasy world by the god Tsukuyomi to be a hero. Powerful beings there reject him and kick him to the edge of the world, leaving him to find his own way.

title: GAMERS!
summary: High school gamer Keita Amano is invited to the game club by Karen Tendou, the school's idol, after she learns he plays. The club shows him a very different side of gaming, and her interest turns his quiet life into comic chaos.

title: My Hero Academia: Heroes Rising
summary: Class 1-A joins a hero safety program on quiet Nabu Island, helping residents with chores. The villain Nine attacks the island in search of a quirk for his plan, and Deku must protect a boy named Katsuma Shimano.

title: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time
summary: High school senior Makoto Konno, unsure about her future, finds by accident that she can leap through time. She plays with her new power, then learns the hard way that every choice has a consequence.

title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO
summary: Ignored by his family and told he has three months to live, 58-year-old Ichirou Inuyashiki is caught in a strange blast and reborn as a mechanized weapon. He uses his powers to save lives, but their origin remains a mystery.

title: Darwin's Game
summary: High school student Kaname Sudou opens a mobile app called Darwin's Game, and a snake from the screen bites his neck. When an opponent appears in real life with a knife, he learns the game is a brutal fight for survival.

title: InuYasha
summary: Fifteen-year-old Kagome Higurashi is dragged down a well into Japan's Sengoku period, where a battle shatters the Shikon Jewel reborn inside her. With half-demon Inuyasha, Shippo, Miroku and Sango, she hunts for its shards.

title: K
summary: After a video of a Red Clansman's murder spreads, student Yashiro Isana is accused and hunted. Joined by the Black Dog Kurou Yatogami, he tries to prove his innocence as gaps in his memory and a conspiracy push the Kings toward war.

title: Himouto! Umaru-chan
summary: Umaru Doma is the perfect high school girl in public, but at home in her hamster hoodie she turns into a lazy, junk food-eating otaku. Her responsible older brother Taihei is left with all of the housework.

title: Food Wars! The Third Plate: Totsuki Train Arc
summary: After the Elite Ten's coup, Azami Nakiri runs Tootsuki and bans creativity on pain of expulsion. Souma Yukihira, the Polar Star Dormitory and Erina Nakiri band together against Central and its plots to expel them.

title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Signs of A Holy War
summary: With Liones won back from the Holy Knights, the Sins, Elizabeth and Hawk enjoy carefree days of meat pies, overdue fights and first love. Then a premonition of a new threat brings signs of a Holy War.

title: Monogatari Series Second Season
summary: A new semester starts with graduation looming for Koyomi Araragi, but then he goes missing. In his absence, a vicious tiger apparition appears and targets Tsubasa Hanekawa, who must fend for herself.

title: Kamisama Kiss
summary: Homeless after her father's debts, Nanami Momozono is given a rundown shrine by the land god Mikage and becomes its new god. She seals a contract with the fox familiar Tomoe, who refuses to serve a human.

title: Monster Musume: Everyday Life With Monster Girls
summary: In a Japan that welcomes non-human species, Kimihito Kurusu becomes host to Miia, a Lamia, and soon gathers a harem of monster girls. Interspecies law forbids romance between them, leaving him in constant trouble.

title: Trigun
summary: Vash the Stampede has a $$60,000,000,000 bounty and a reputation as the Humanoid Typhoon, yet he avoids violence at all costs. Trailed by insurance agents Meryl and Milly across Gunsmoke, he faces legendary assassins.

title: Teasing Master Takagi-san
summary: Classmate Takagi teases Nishikata every day and predicts exactly how he will react, so his comebacks never land. Nishikata vows that someday he will tease her back and make her blush with embarrassment.

title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun
summary: Fourteen-year-old Iruma Suzuki is sold by his parents to the demon Sullivan, who only wants a grandchild. Sent to the demon school Babyls, Iruma tries to hide that he is human but keeps drawing attention.

title: The Melancholy of Haruhi Suzumiya Season 2
summary: Kyon keeps getting dragged into strange events by the SOS Brigade and its leader Haruhi Suzumiya, alongside Mikuru, Yuki and Itsuki. Whether it is summer vacation or the school festival, things always turn odd.

title: More than a Married Couple, but Not Lovers.
summary: In a Couple Practical course, Jirou Yakuin is paired with gyaru Akari Watanabe while their crushes Shiori and Minami are paired together. They agree to cooperate and reach the top ten so they can exchange partners.

title: takt op.Destiny
summary: After the black Kuroya Meteorite falls, monsters called D2 overrun the land and are drawn to melodies, so music becomes taboo. Girls called Musicart draw power from humanity's great scores to fight the D2.

title: Magi: The Kingdom of Magic
summary: After victory over Al-Thamen, Aladdin and his friends leave Sindria and part ways. Aladdin heads to Magnostadt, a country ruled by magicians, Alibaba trains, Morgiana seeks her homeland, and a great war looms.

title: Tomodachi Game
summary: Katagiri Yuuichi, who values friendship above all, is dragged with his four close friends into a debt repayment game. The only way to win is to never doubt each other, but trust soon proves hard to keep.

title: K-ON! Season 2
summary: Now third-years, the Light Music Club seniors try to recruit members so Azusa Nakano will not be alone after they graduate. When nobody joins, the five set out to make their last year together an exciting one.

title: Sword Art Online Alternative: Gun Gale Online
summary: Tall, shy university student Karen Kohiruimaki finds her ideal small self as LLENN, the Pink Devil of Gun Gale Online. After meeting the eccentric Pitohui, she enters Squad Jam, a team battle royale.

title: A Place Further Than the Universe
summary: Second-year Mari Tamaki meets Shirase Kobuchizawa, who is saving up to search Antarctica for her missing mother. Mari joins her, and with Hinata Miyake and Yuzuki Shiraishi they set sail for the frozen south.

title: Little Witch Academia (TV)
summary: Inspired by the witch Shiny Chariot, Akko Kagari enrolls at Luna Nova Magical Academy despite her non-magical background. She befriends Lotte and Sucy, finds the Shiny Rod, and tries to keep up with rival Diana Cavendish.

title: Kizumonogatari Part 1: Tekketsu
summary: Honor student Tsubasa Hanekawa tells Koyomi Araragi of a rumored blonde vampire in town. That night he follows a trail of blood into a subway station and finds the vampire dismembered, calling for his help.

title: Horimiya: The Missing Pieces
summary: As graduation at Katagiri High School ends, Kyouko Hori, Izumi Miyamura and their friends look back on their time as students, piecing together the fleeting, colorful moments they shared.

title: Laid-Back Camp
summary: Rin Shima loves camping alone at the base of Mount Fuji. Her solo trip turns into a night for two when the lost Nadeshiko Kagamihara takes refuge at her campsite, sharing ramen by the fire.

title: Haganai
summary: Transfer student Kodaka Hasegawa is branded a delinquent and stays friendless. With fellow loner Yozora Mikazuki, he starts the Neighbor's Club to learn how to make friends, soon joined by Sena Kashiwazaki and other outcasts.

title: Nisekoi:
summary: Raku Ichijou and Chitoge Kirisaki keep up their fake relationship as Chitoge starts to fall for him. A new girl joins Raku's admirers, while his search for his first love and the secret of the sealed locket goes on.

title: Sentenced to Be a Hero
summary: Xylo Forbartz, a condemned goddess killer, fights endless monstrous hordes in Penal Hero Unit 9004, where death only means resurrection. Meeting a mysterious new goddess sparks a rebellion against eternal punishment.

title: Amagi Brilliant Park
summary: Narcissist Seiya Kanie thinks Isuzu Sento asked him on a date, but she and Princess Latifa want him to manage Amagi Brilliant Park, a run-down park staffed by magical Maple Landers that needs 500,000 guests in three months.

title: Akudama Drive
summary: In neon Kansai, a mysterious message hires several elite Akudama criminals to free Cutthroat, a killer of 999 people, before his public execution, pulling dangerous fugitives into one place for a bloodbath.

title: BTOOOM!
summary: Unemployed gamer Ryouta Sakamoto wakes on a remote island with a crystal in his hand, trapped in a real-life Btooom! where players must kill seven others with bombs. He teams up with fellow player Himiko to escape.

title: Made in Abyss: Dawn of the Deep Soul
summary: Riko, Regu, and Nanachi reach the fifth layer and the research station Idofront, where Prushka, said to be Bondrewd's daughter, leads them to the White Whistle behind Nanachi's dark past.

title: The Dangers in My Heart
summary: Kyoutarou, a boy who daydreams about murdering his classmates, finds a spark in his dark heart after meeting Anna Yamada, the gorgeous class idol. Neither of them is who they seem at first glance.

title: The Millionaire Detective - Balance: UNLIMITED
summary: Super-rich Daisuke Kanbe joins the Modern Crime Prevention Headquarters as a detective and is paired with Haru Katou, who hates how Daisuke throws money at cases. The clashing pair must still solve crimes together.

title: Kuroko's Basketball 3
summary: Seirin reaches the Winter Cup semifinals with Kaijou, Rakuzan, and Shuutoku, each led by a Generation of Miracles member. Kuroko's team play clashes with a perfect copy and an absolute authority in the final push.

title: Mieruko-chan
summary: High school student Miko suddenly starts seeing gruesome monsters everywhere. Terrified, she pretends not to notice them and carries on with daily life to keep herself and her friend Hana out of danger.

title: The Testament of Sister New Devil
summary: Basara Toujou's new stepsisters Mio and Maria turn out to be demons, Mio the daughter of the former Demon Lord. A former Hero himself, Basara forms a master-servant contract with Mio and vows to protect them.

title: In/Spectre
summary: Kotoko Iwanaga, the God of Wisdom who mediates between youkai and humans, teams with university student Kurou Sakuragawa to stop a faceless woman with a steel beam who appears after an idol dies under falling beams.

title: Land of the Lustrous
summary: In a future of crystalline Gems at war with the Lunarians, fragile Phos is told to write an encyclopedia instead of fighting. Meeting the lonely, poisonous Cinnabar, Phos seeks a role both rejected Gems can enjoy.

title: The Way of the Househusband
summary: Immortal Tatsu, a legendary yakuza, quits violence to become a house husband. He takes on supermarket sales and kitchen failures with dead seriousness, while misunderstandings about him follow him everywhere.

title: Tsukigakirei
summary: In their last year of junior high, aspiring writer Kotarou Azumi and track team member Akane Mizuno land in the same class. Chance meetings spark first love, along with anxiety and rival affections.

title: Yu Yu Hakusho: Ghostfiles
summary: Delinquent Yuusuke Urameshi dies saving a boy from a car, and Koenma lets him earn back his life as a Spirit Detective. Guided by Botan and joined by Kuwabara, Hiei, and Kurama, he battles threats to humanity.

title: Ergo Proxy
summary: In the domed city of Romdo, robots called AutoReivs catch the Cogito Virus and gain self-awareness. Re-l Mayer, her partner Iggy, specialist Vincent Law, and child AutoReiv Pino chase the truth about the Proxies.

title: Kaiju No. 8 Season 2
summary: Moved to the Defense Force's First Division under Gen Narumi, Kafka must prove his worth. When he fails to transform during a fight with ant-like kaiju, Kaiju No. 9 attacks to kill him and steal his power.

title: Moriarty the Patriot
summary: In 19th-century Britain, noble William James Moriarty quietly helps common folk with their problems while plotting with his brothers Albert and Louis to destroy the class system, even if blood must be spilled.

title: My Love Story!!
summary: Big, kind-hearted freshman Takeo Gouda falls for Rinko Yamato after saving her from a molester. Sure she likes his handsome best friend Sunakawa, he decides to play cupid for her instead.

title: In Another World With My Smartphone
summary: Killed by a stray lightning bolt from God, Touya Mochizuki is reborn in a magical world and keeps his smartphone as his one wish. He finds a gift for magic and companions like Linze, Elze, Yumina, Leen, and Yae.

title: Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun
summary: Picking up directly after Dawn of the Deep Soul, Riko, Reg, and Nanachi carry their adventure down into the Sixth Layer of the Abyss, a place known as The Capital of the Unreturned.

title: Paprika
summary: When the DC Mini, a device that lets therapists enter dreams, is stolen, Atsuko Chiba and Kosaku Tokita team up with Officer Konakawa to hunt a mental terrorist across the real world and the world of dreams.

title: The Asterisk War
summary: Scholarship student Ayato Amagiri transfers to Seidoukan Academy, where Genestella duel in Festas, and angers Julis-Alexia von Riessfeld by seeing her half-dressed. His real goal is to find his missing elder sister.

title: The Familiar of Zero
summary: Louise the Zero, a mage who cannot cast spells properly, summons a boy named Saito Hiraga as her familiar and treats him like a slave. Then a strange brand on his hand marks him as the powerful familiar Gandalfr.
