title: Blue Period
summary: Bored high schooler Yatora Yaguchi gets hooked on art after seeing an Art Club painting and decides to make it his career, despite doubtful parents, skilled peers, and a subject deeper than he expected.

title: Say "I love you".
summary: Mei Tachibana has avoided people since friends betrayed her in grade school, until popular Yamato Kurosawa insists on being her friend and kisses her to fend off a stalker. They start dating, and she struggles to show her feelings.

title: A Certain Scientific Railgun
summary: Mikoto Misaka, the third-ranked Level 5 esper in Academy City, and her friends look into crimes tied to the Level Upper, a device said to boost esper levels, and find the city far more twisted than it looks.

title: So I'm a Spider, So What?
summary: A disaster kills a whole high school class, and most are reborn in another world as nobles and princes. One girl is reborn as the weakest kind of spider and must hunt, level up, and evolve to survive.

title: ZOMBIE LAND SAGA
summary: Ten years after dying in a traffic accident, would-be idol Sakura Minamoto wakes as a zombie in Saga. Manager Koutarou Tatsumi forms her and six other zombie girls into the idol group Franchouchou to save the prefecture.

title: WataMote: No Matter How I Look At It, It's You Guys' Fault I'm Not Popular!
summary: After 50 simulated high school lives in dating games, Tomoko Kuroki thinks she is ready for high school. In reality she is awkward and friendless, and she is the only one who does not see it.

title: One-Punch Man Season 3
summary: Monsters from the Monster Association take a Hero Association executive's child hostage, and the S-class heroes plan a raid on their hideout. Meanwhile Garou, the human monster they captured, wakes up inside it.

title: Blue Box
summary: Badminton player Taiki Inomata falls hard for upperclassman Chinatsu Kano of the girls' basketball team. When an unexpected turn of events brings them closer, sports may not be first on their minds.

title: Wandering Witch: The Journey of Elaina
summary: Inspired by stories of the travelling witch Nike, Elaina works through trials to become a full-fledged witch. She then sets out on her journey, meeting people and hearing their stories, both bright and dark.

title: Attack on Titan: No Regrets
summary: Long before joining the Survey Corps, young Levi runs a criminal gang in the Underground with Isabel and Farlan. Promised citizenship if they kill squad leader Erwin Smith, the trio joins his expedition team to get close.

title: Barakamon
summary: Narcissistic calligrapher Seishuu Handa loses his cool when a veteran calls his work unoriginal, so his father exiles him to the Goto Islands. There, nosy neighbors like young Naru Kotoishi keep barging into his house.

title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4
summary: After the costly victory at Priestella, Subaru seeks a way to save Rem, Crusch, and Julius. He and his crew cross the uncharted Auguria Dunes toward the Pleiades Watchtower and Shaula, an all-seeing wise woman.

title: Gleipnir
summary: Shuuichi Kagaya can turn into a monster and hides it, until Claire Aoki, a girl he saved from a fire, blackmails him with a photo. She drags him into her search for her sister, who also became a monster.

title: I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World and Became Unrivaled in The Real World, Too
summary: Bullied at school and neglected by his parents, Yuuya finds a strange door in his late grandfather's home that leads to a magical world. He brings its treasures and powerful skills back to Earth for a new life.

title: Sound! Euphonium
summary: Euphonist Kumiko Oumae starts high school hoping to leave music behind, but ends up in the chaotic brass band with Hazuki, Sapphire, Asuka, Shuuichi, and Reina, which new advisor Noboru Taki pushes toward nationals.

title: Uzaki-chan Wants to Hang Out!
summary: College freshman Hana Uzaki reunites with Shinichi Sakurai, her upperclassman from high school, now a loner. She keeps dragging him out so he is never alone, and people start to mistake them for a couple.

title: ODDTAXI
summary: Kotokawa, a solitary taxi driver who listens to Rakugo on the radio, drives quirky passengers around the city. Their idle conversations, from a nurse with a secret to a rookie idol group, all lead to a girl who disappeared.

title: Kaguya-sama: Love is War -The First Kiss That Never Ends-
summary: After their first kiss at the Hoshin Festival, Kaguya Shinomiya and Miyuki Shirogane still have no clear confession. Now Christmas arrives, with Shirogane wanting it perfect and Kaguya chasing the imperfect.

title: Food Wars! The Fifth Plate
summary: With Tootsuki back in order, Souma and his friends enter the BLUE, a contest for young chefs seeking world fame, facing new rivals and Asahi Saiba, leader of the underworld chef group Noir.

title: HINAMATSURI
summary: Yakuza Yoshifumi Nitta is hit on the head by a capsule holding Hina, a girl with immense powers who explodes if she cannot use them. Stuck as her caregiver, he finds she may be an asset to his yakuza business.

title: The Tatami Galaxy
summary: A lonely third-year student meets a self-proclaimed god of matrimony and regrets two bitter years with his friend Ozu. Then he is flung back to the start of college to live it again, hoping to ask out Akashi.

title: My First Girlfriend is a Gal
summary: After a prank by his friends, hopeless virgin Junichi Hashiba asks out the gal Yukana Yame. Though disgusted at first, she bonds with him through teasing and accepts his confession, to his surprise.

title: Date A Live II
summary: Having sealed three Spirits, Shidou Itsuka keeps working with Ratatoskr to find and date more of them. This time, a more imposing threat beyond the Spirits has noticed what they are doing.

title: Pokémon
summary: On his 10th birthday, young Satoshi gets the rebellious Pikachu as his first Pokemon. With Kasumi and Takeshi, he travels the regions to earn eight Gym Badges while foiling Team Rocket's schemes to steal Pokemon.

title: Asobi Asobase - workshop of fun -
summary: Transfer student Olivia, loud airhead Hanako Honda, and deadpan loner Kasumi Nomura bond over recess games and form the Pastime Club, where failed English lessons and bids for popularity fill their days.

title: The Disappearance of Haruhi Suzumiya
summary: On a cold Christmas, Kyon finds that Haruhi Suzumiya has vanished and nobody remembers her or the SOS Brigade. Itsuki is gone too, Mikuru fears him, and a shy Yuki runs the Literature Club in the old club room.

title: My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom!
summary: A girl regains her past-life memories and learns she is reborn as Katarina Claes, the villain of the game Fortune Lover who meets doom in every ending. She uses her game knowledge to dodge her death flags.

title: Kizumonogatari Part 3: Reiketsu
summary: Araragi has beaten the three vampire hunters and recovered Kiss-shot's limbs. Now, as she nears full power, he must decide if reviving her is what he wants, and wonders how a newborn vampire could beat her hunters.

title: Maquia: When the Promised Flower Blooms
summary: Maquia, an orphan of the long-lived Iorph, is swept away when Mezarte's army and its Renato dragons destroy her homeland. Alone in a forest, she finds a human baby, names him Ariel, and resolves to raise him.

title: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Separation
summary: After Yhwach's surprise attack, Soul Reaper captains train to fight without Bankai while Ichigo undergoes brutal training. Yhwach names Uryuu Ishida his successor and strikes the weakened Soul Society again.

title: Oreimo
summary: Average teen Kyousuke finds an erotic game belonging to his flawless model sister Kirino. Sworn to secrecy, he is pulled into her otaku world, meeting Ruri Gokou and Saori Makishima along the way.

title: Hellsing
summary: Sir Integra, leader of the Hellsing organization, sends her vampire Alucard to wipe out ghouls in the village of Cheddar. Mortally wounded officer Seras Victoria accepts his offer to live on as a vampire.

title: Takopi's Original Sin
summary: Takopi, a Happy alien, lands on Earth to spread happiness and vows to make lonely fourth grader Shizuka smile with his Happy Gadgets. As he uncovers her pain, he learns gadgets may not be enough.

title: Hajime no Ippo: The Fighting!
summary: Bullied all his life, Ippo is saved by the boxer Takamura and wakes up in the Kamogawa boxing gym. When he asks to learn boxing, he gets an impossible task with a one-week limit and trains relentlessly to beat it.

title: And you thought there is never a girl online?
summary: Years after a crushing rejection in an online game, otaku Rusian accepts a marriage proposal from Ako, a girl avatar in his guild. At an offline meeting, he learns Ako and his guildmates are all girls from his school.

title: Fate/stay night [Heaven's Feel] I. presage flower
summary: Nearly ten years after the last Grail War ravaged Fuyuki, Shirou Emiya joins the Fifth with Saber. When a murderous shadow appears, he allies with Rin Toosaka, and his feelings for Sakura Matou pull him into dark secrets.

title: Violet Evergarden: Eternity and the Auto Memory Doll
summary: Violet Evergarden is hired to tutor Isabella York, a noble girl who sees her academy as a prison. As Isabella opens up, she reveals she has lost touch with her younger sister Taylor, and Violet offers to help her write a letter.

title: Lucky☆Star
summary: Lazy otaku Konata Izumi, the Hiiragi twins Tsukasa and Kagami, and polite Miyuki Takara share daily school life, musing on everything from otaku culture and tradition to the right way to eat food.

title: The Summer Hikaru Died
summary: In a rural Japanese village, best friends Yoshiki and Hikaru are inseparable until Hikaru comes back from the mountains no longer himself. Something has taken over his body, memories, and feelings.

title: The Fruit of Grisaia
summary: Transfer student Yuuji Kazami arrives at Mihama Academy, home to just the principal and five girls. Hoping for an ordinary life, he learns each girl hides a trauma, and he may be the one to save them.

title: Evangelion: 1.0 You Are (Not) Alone
summary: In Tokyo-3, the last human city in Japan, 14-year-old Shinji Ikari is asked by his estranged father Gendou to pilot Evangelion Unit-01 for Nerv. Hoping to reconcile, Shinji agrees to fight the invading Angels.

title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 4
summary: As Tempest prospers, Granville Rozzo and his granddaughter Maribel clash with Rimuru over their plan to protect mankind by ruling it. In El Dorado, Demon Lord Leon pursues his own goals as a new Hero nears.

title: Tokyo Revengers Season 2
summary: Takemichi Hanagaki leaps back again to investigate Black Dragon, the gang whose actions lead to Hinata's death. With Chifuyu, he meets Hakkai Shiba, whose older brother Taiju rules Black Dragon like a tyrant.

title: My Happy Marriage
summary: Abused by her family, Miyo is married off to Kiyoka, a soldier whose fiancees all fled within three days. Despite a cold welcome at the Kudou household, she stays, cooks, and does chores, and the two slowly open up.

title: Citrus
summary: Fashionable Yuzu Aihara transfers to a strict all-girls school after her mother remarries, and clashes with the cold student council president Mei. Then Mei turns out to be her new stepsister and kisses her.

title: The Last: Naruto the Movie
summary: Two years after the Fourth Great Ninja War, the moon nears Earth and Toneri Oosutuski abducts Hinata's sister Hanabi. Naruto, Sakura, Shikamaru, Sai, and Hinata race to rescue her, and Naruto fights for love.

title: Kizumonogatari Part 2: Nekketsu
summary: Now part vampire, Koyomi Araragi fights three hunters to recover Kiss-shot's stolen limbs: vampire Dramaturgie, half-vampire Episode, and priest Guillotinecutter. Every minute makes him more vampire.

title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King
summary: Wang Ling, a cultivation genius who has reached a new realm every two years since age one, is nearly invincible. At sixteen he faces his greatest battle yet: keeping a low profile in senior high school.

title: Daemons of the Shadow Realm
summary: In a remote mountain village watched over by two stone guardians, young Yuru lives off the land near his twin sister Asa, who carries out a mysterious duty for the village while locked in a cage.

title: Bottom-Tier Character Tomozaki
summary: Fumiya Tomozaki is Japan's top player of the game Tackfam but a loner at school. When fellow top player Aoi Hinami turns out to be his popular classmate, she sets out to coach him in the game of life.

title: Plunderer
summary: In Alcia, numbers called Counts set each person's status, and a Count of zero sends them to the Abyss. Hina searches for the legendary Aces and meets Licht Bach, a masked man with a negative Count who is secretly one.

title: A Sign of Affection
summary: College student Yuki Itose is struggling on a train when upperclassman Itsuomi Nagi helps her out. As he opens a new world to her, she falls for him, and a pure love story begins to grow.

title: Yosuga no Sora
summary: After losing their parents in a car accident, twins Haruka and Sora Kasugano move to their grandfather's countryside house. Childhood friends greet them, but buried feelings and a dark secret begin to surface.

title: Fairy Tail Final Season
summary: With Fairy Tail disbanded, Natsu, Happy, and Lucy set out to reunite the guild. Their hardest trial yet comes as the Alvarez Empire's huge army, led by an all-too-familiar ruler, invades Fiore.

title: To Love Ru
summary: Timid Rito Yuuki still cannot confess to Haruna Sairenji when Lala Satalin Deviluke, a runaway alien princess, crash-lands in his bath. To escape a political marriage, she decides to marry him instead.

title: Seirei Gensouki: Spirit Chronicles
summary: Haruto's memories awaken in Rio, a slum boy seeking revenge for his murdered mother. With a new special power, Rio saves a kidnapped Bertram princess and wins a place at the noble Royal Academy, where he is scorned.

title: How a Realist Hero Rebuilt the Kingdom
summary: Summoned to another world, Kazuya Souma is betrothed to the princess and put on the throne. Instead of war or adventure, he gathers talented people to rebuild the flagging economy through administrative reform.

title: Dr. STONE New World Part 2
summary: Kohaku and Ginrou sneak into the Petrification Kingdom leader's harem with Amaryllis's help, until a slip exposes them to Minister Ibara and the warrior Moz. Moz, who wants the device himself, may become Senkuu's ally.

title: Steins;Gate The Movie – Load Region of Déjà Vu
summary: Back in Akihabara after a year in America, Kurisu Makise reunites with Okabe, who then vanishes as time travel side effects build. Only she remembers him, and she must choose whether to time travel to save him.

title: I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level
summary: Reborn as an immortal witch, ex-salarywoman Azusa Aizawa kills slimes for 300 years and hits max level by accident. She tries to hide it to keep her quiet life, but the dragon Raika and others come calling.

title: BAKI
summary: After winning the underground tournament, Baki Hanma learns from Tokugawa Mitsunari that five dangerous death row martial artists have escaped and are heading to Tokyo, each wanting to taste defeat.

title: ORESUKI: Are you the only one who loves me?
summary: Jouro Kisaragi goes on dates with Cosmos and Himawari, only for both to ask for help winning his best friend Sun-chan. Secretly a schemer, he plans to claim one girl, until gloomy Pansy sees through him and confesses.

title: Blood Lad
summary: Staz Charlie Blood, a vampire boss in Demon World who loves Japanese otaku culture, meets human Fuyumi Yanagi, who dies in an attack on his turf. Now a ghost, she joins his hunt for magic to bring her back.

title: BEASTARS Season 2
summary: After an alpaca is murdered at Cherryton Academy and Louis turns down the Beastar role and leaves, the council offers the title to whoever finds the killer. Legoshi investigates while wrestling with feelings for Haru.

title: Golden Kamuy
summary: In early 1900s Hokkaido, ex-soldier Saichi Sugimoto hunts a stolen Ainu gold fortune whose map is tattooed on a killer's cellmates. He teams up with Asirpa, a young Ainu girl whose father was one of the murdered Ainu.

title: Megalobox
summary: Junk Dog throws underground Megalo Box fights until champion Yuuri knocks him out in one round and dares him to climb to his ring. Taking the name Joe, he enters the Megalonia tournament with three months to qualify.

title: PSYCHO-PASS 2
summary: A year and a half on, Inspector Akane Tsunemori works with rigid junior inspector Mika Shimotsuki when a figure who can control the Crime Coefficient kills an enforcer and leaves WC? scrawled in blood.

title: Girls' Last Tour
summary: Chito and Yuuri, the last survivors of a war-torn city, ride a motorbike through frozen ruins, scavenging old military sites for food and parts between shooting practice, new books, and snowball fights.

title: Myriad Colors Phantom World
summary: After a brain virus reveals phantoms living among humans, Haruhiko Ichijou, who seals phantoms with drawings, and Mai Kawakami, who fights with elemental martial arts, handle phantom trouble as Hosea Academy's Team E.
